title_en: Active-Duty Enlistment Recruitment Schedule for All Armed Forces Branches (December 2026)

Persons liable for military service who wish to apply for a military specialty related to their major, qualifications, licences or experience should consult the attached recruitment plan for the detailed schedule. The attachment was not read, so its dates and procedures are not included here.

translation:
Title: Active-Duty Soldier Recruitment Schedule for Each Armed Forces Branch (December 2026)

The Military Manpower Administration (병무청) operates an active-duty soldier recruitment system that allows persons liable for military service to apply for a military specialty related to their major, qualifications, licences or experience, and to serve in that field. We hereby announce, as attached, the recruitment schedule for active-duty soldiers in each branch of the armed forces for those who apply in December 2026 and enlist in March 2027.

Attachment (1 file): '26년 12월 각 군 현역병 모집계획(배부용).hwpx (December 2026 Recruitment Plan for Active-Duty Soldiers in Each Branch, for distribution) (1 MB). [The content of this attachment was not read.]
